kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: pastas (penne with Gorgonzola cream, Genovese with shrimp), fried blue crab and maitake fritters (2026 reviews).
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cicchetti, prosciutto, pâté, cheese and seafood pastas (2026 reviews). Some vegetable plates (marinated purple cabbage, eggplant with balsamic), but no vegan menu is mentioned.
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Wed 15:00–24:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 23:30); Fri–Sun 15:00–1:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 0:30); 15:00–17:00 drinks and light snacks, then dinner and bar; light snacks only after 22:00. Closed Thursday and other irregular days — check the shop's Instagram. Reservations taken; dessert plates by phone; courses by the day before. Standing at the counter is free; tables carry a ¥400 seat charge at dinner — Tabelog, Japanese original 「スタンディングはチャージなし、テーブルはお席代400円」. 36 places: 20 standing, 16 at high tables. Non-smoking. Cards, e-money and QR. English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Children welcome.
kyoto_il_lago_bacaro.notes: [Italian standing bar · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, a Venetian bacaro] A Venice-style bacaro near City Hall: stand at the front counter for cicchetti and a glass of wine from about ¥1,800, or take a high table for pasta, fritters and courses. Open from 3 pm to midnight or 1 am; English menu. ¥400 table charge, standing free. Closed Thursday.

roles: Operator: 株式会社HOTTA (NTA invoice registration at the shop address)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 November 2017 (Tabelog). 2026 reviewers describe a lively place, popular with diners in their 20s, used for girls' nights and birthdays, with attentive staff and an extensive wine list; weekday tables were nearly fully booked in August 2026 while the standing counter was quiet.
chef_bio.philosophy: Modeled on the bacari of Venice (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Cicchetti; pastas; Italian wine by the glass.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "I had researched beforehand and found this Italian place inspired by the bacari of Venice, which opens at 3:00 PM… Leaning against the counter while chatting casually with the staff and sipping beer was fantastic."
April 2026: "The marinated purple cabbage was especially delicious, so I ordered it twice. The wine selection was also extensive."

kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: sukiyaki simmered in a sweet secret sauce (warishita) that reviewers say comes from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui (April–May 2026 reviews); soy-based sauces normally contain wheat.
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an A5 Wagyu sukiyaki shop; egg yolk and cheese in the finishing rice (2026 reviews).
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon and Wed–Sun and holidays 12:00–21:00; closed Tuesday. Reservations taken. 12 seats: 8 at the counter and private rooms for 2 and 4 (sunken kotatsu seating per a 2026 review); private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR (incl. Alipay, WeChat Pay). Basement of the 祇園ファーストビル on the Shijo-dori approach to Yasaka Shrine, about a minute from the shrine. Opened 1 May 2026.
kyoto_wagyu_ichinone.notes: [Wagyu sukiyaki · Gion by Yasaka Shrine, a basement counter] A new (May 2026) basement counter a minute from Yasaka Shrine serving one-person A5 Wagyu sukiyaki bubbling in a hot stone pot — about ¥4,700–5,300 for 120g — finished with cheesy stone-grilled rice. Open from noon. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2026 (Tabelog). The listing says each cut of Wagyu is chosen by a master connoisseur; a May 2026 reviewer calls the sauce a company secret, and an April 2026 reviewer says it comes from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui. Reviewers describe the staff cooking the sukiyaki for the diner. Operator not identified; one April 2026 review was written at a pre-opening tasting.
chef_bio.specialty: Stone-pot A5 Wagyu sukiyaki; cheese stone-grilled rice.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "The dipping sauce deserves special mention. Sourced from a long-established Japanese restaurant in Fukui, its balance of sweetness and richness elevates the meat's flavor."
May 2026: "You don't have to worry about cooking it yourself; it's delicious right from the start… The secret sauce is a company secret."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和牛一乃音 WAGYU ICHINONE、すき焼き・牛料理、東山区祇園町北側281-1-1 祇園ファーストビル B1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月・水〜日・祝 12:00〜21:00、火曜休み、予約可、12席 (カウンター8席、2名・4名の個室)、貸切20名まで、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2026年5月1日オープン、目利きが選ぶ和牛を石焼で。口コミ (2026年4月〜6月、英語、うち1件はプレオープン): 一人用の石焼すき焼き、A5ミスジまたはA5ロースを60g・120g・180gで、A5ミスジ120g 4,700円、A5ロース120g 5,300円、割り下は福井の老舗日本料理店のものとの記載、七味と山椒、締めはチーズの石焼ごはん (卵黄入り)、八坂神社から徒歩1分。

kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a Kyoto oden shop whose menu runs to croquettes, ham and tenderloin cutlets, fried oysters, shrimp fry and fried sardines; oden includes chikuwa and other fish cakes (2023–2026 reviews). Ask about plain oden items such as daikon and egg — the broth was not described.
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi with egg and beef tendon, sashimi, cutlets (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:30; closed Sunday; hours and closed days may change, so check before visiting. Reservations taken — a November 2024 reviewer says they are a must. No credit cards (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, 8 at tables. Non-smoking. In the ザ・マインビル, down the first alley north off Sueyoshi-cho east of Hanamikoji (November 2024 review). The shop moved here before December 2023.
kyoto_saidokoro_yasukawa.notes: [Oden & obanzai · Gion north of Shijo, an alley counter] A cheerful 14-seat oden counter tucked down a Gion alley: light Kyoto oden at about ¥300 a piece, obanzai, cutlets and an oden-broth potato salad, or a ¥4,000 omakase course. Reasonable for Gion. Book ahead; no cards. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers since January 2023 describe a homey oden and obanzai shop that relocated within Gion before December 2023, with a cheerful owner who sees guests off and prices well below the Gion norm. Criticism: two reviewers found the oden broth too light or not fully soaked into every item (February and November 2024).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style oden; oden potato salad; fried small potatoes.

anecdotes.text: April 2025: "Oh, and I also ordered the oden potato salad as an extra! It was like egg salad but with the flavor of oden broth—simply exquisite! This is a must-order!"
December 2023: "This was my first visit since they relocated, and the oden was just as good as ever, cooked in a wonderfully flavorful broth."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 菜処 やすかわ、おでん・日本料理、東山区祇園町北側347-133 ザ・マインビル 1F、月〜土18:00〜23:30、日曜休み、営業時間・定休日は変更の可能性あり、予約可、カード不可、14席 (カウンター6・テーブル8)、禁煙。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年4月、英語): 移転後も変わらぬ京風のおでん (2023年12月)、大根・卵・こんにゃく・しらたき・ちくわ・がんも・牛すじ、1品300円で牛すじは少し高め (2026年4月)、おまかせコース4,000円 (おばんざい、刺身、おでん5品、揚げ物3品、ごはん1品、2025年4月)、おでんのポテトサラダ、だし巻き、小芋の揚げ物、コロッケ、ハムカツ、ヒレカツ、カキフライ、その場で握るおにぎり、まぐろのたたき、明るい店主、予約必須との声 (2024年11月)、だしが薄いとの声 (2024年2月・11月)。

kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based Kyoto kappo with fried fu and soy-seasoned dishes (2011–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi throughout, sashimi, hamo, squid (2011–2025 reviews).
kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–21:00; closed Mondays (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ料無し。」). Bento to order, with delivery (Tabelog); a 2024 regular says bento must be ordered ahead. 15 seats; a private room for 4 (Tabelog). Down a narrow alley off Kawaramachi south of Sanjo, 3 min from Sanjo (Tabelog; 2011 and July 2025 reviews).
kyoto_kawashige_sanjo.notes: [Kyoto kappo · Sanjo] A worn, quiet counter kappo down an alley off Kawaramachi-Sanjo, open since 1942 and among the first of its kind, still cooking bento for Gion tea houses: classic Kyoto courses from about ¥8,000, bento by order. About ¥15,000–20,000 at dinner.

chef_bio.background: Established in 1942, one of the pioneering counter kappo of Kyoto, which has trained many chefs and caters to Gion tea houses (September 2011 review); a July 2025 diner had heard it used to cater for Pontocho tea houses. Tabelog names Masako Shirasu, Shotaro Ikenami and Junichiro Tanizaki among those who loved it.
chef_bio.specialty: Counter kappo; bento for tea houses.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 group dinner found the soup, grilled and simmered dishes rooted in sound training, but wished for more than one sake, Kiku Masamune.
A diner with memories going back 38 years still receives summer and New Year greetings from the shop, and recommends the bento ordered ahead (April 2024).
A November 2022 diner in kimono ate the shop's bento at a Gion tea house, down to the momiji tofu and kuzumochi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 河しげ 三条本店、日本料理、中京区河原町通三条下る東入大黒町46、三条駅・京阪三条駅から徒歩3分、火〜日 11:30〜13:30・17:30〜21:00、月曜休み、チャージ料無し、15席、4人用の個室、仕出し弁当と配達、コースは8,000円から、Masako Shirasu・Shotaro Ikenami・Junichiro Tanizaki ゆかりの店 (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2008〜2025年、英語): 1942年創業、カウンター割烹の先駆け、祇園のお茶屋に仕出し、おまかせ15,000円から (2011年)、Akashi の鯛、鱧、トロ、aori いか、栗と銀杏、生麩の揚げ物、momiji 豆腐と葛餅の弁当 (2022年11月)、日本酒は2011年は Tamano Hikari、2025年7月は Kiku Masamune のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Traditional counter kappo.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2025.

kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.gf_detail: Ask. Shabu-shabu meat and vegetables, but ponzu, sesame and miso dipping sauces and the ramen to finish are wheat or soy-based (2014–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, beef and chicken shabu-shabu (2014–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ料なし」). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 80 seats, tables and sunken kotatsu; non-smoking, smoking near the entrance (Tabelog; February 2021 review). 2nd floor, 1 min from exit 15 of Karasuma / Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_tonshabu_hide_shijo_karasuma.notes: [Pork shabu-shabu · Shijo-Karasuma] A big, homely second-floor shabu-shabu room a minute from Karasuma, popular with overseas visitors: pork, chicken or beef with free refills of vegetables, cheap set courses and lunch hot pots. About ¥3,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: The Shijo-Karasuma main shop of three (with 京都離れ店 and 心斎橋店; own site). Homely service by older women on the staff (November 2023 and January 2026 reviews); English greetings and many overseas guests (November 2018 and December 2022 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A New Year 2026 diner found the room nearly full by 6 pm and liked the older women on the staff and the free refills.
An April 2026 couple splurged on the pork, beef and chicken all-you-can-eat course and managed only one extra plate of beef.
A November 2023 diner who booked at the last minute was surprised by the warm welcome.

cultural_comfort.note: Staff greet in English; many overseas guests (2018 and 2022 reviews).

kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: madeleines, egg tarts, financiers, roll cake and tarts (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter and egg baked sweets, café latte (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–18:00; hours may change (Tabelog). A February 2025 review gives Wed–Fri 12:00–18:00 and Sat 12:00–20:00. Seats upstairs require ordering food; drinks alone at the counter or the bench outside; shoes off upstairs (2025–26 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). One table for six upstairs and a bench in front (2025–26 reviews). On Komonmae Street among antique shops and galleries, near Sanjo (Tabelog; January 2026 review).
kyoto_cafe_loto_sanjo.notes: [Café · Komonmae Street] A tiny coffee stand in a renovated townhouse among the antique shops of Komonmae Street, by a cookery researcher: espresso drinks and fresh madeleines, egg tarts and seasonal cakes, with one shared table upstairs (shoes off) or a bench outside. About ¥1,000–2,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 February 2023; a café of the cookery researcher Masayo Takeda (February 2025 review), who also heads a culinary research institute (January 2026 review). Designed by the architect Yasushi Horibe, which draws architecture fans (February 2026 review). Latte-art events (August 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Madeleines and egg tarts with coffee.

anecdotes.text: After a Mika Ninagawa exhibition at the Kyoto City KYOCERA Museum of Art (March 2025), a visitor had a madeleine and café latte on the bench outside.
A March 2025 visitor who rarely eats egg tarts was won over by a burst of vanilla.
A January 2026 visitor arrived just as the madeleines came out of the oven and took more away.

kyoto_the_door_takakura.gf_detail: Ask. A bar with a full food menu — carbonara, katsu sandwich, omurice — mostly wheat; cheese and nuts may suit (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_door_takakura.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks and mixed nuts; most food is meat, egg or cheese (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_the_door_takakura.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–02:00; irregular closures (Tabelog); last order 2 am (May 2026 review). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥600 (Tabelog Japanese original 「チャージ600円」). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money (Tabelog). 31 seats: 9 at the counter, 22 at tables, private rooms upstairs; smoking allowed (Tabelog; May 2025 review). In a remodelled townhouse on Takakura just south of Shijo, by Daimaru (Tabelog).
kyoto_the_door_takakura.notes: [Machiya bar · Shijo-Takakura] A bar in a remodelled townhouse by Daimaru, with a counter and small garden downstairs and private rooms upstairs: single-malt highballs, cocktails and a surprisingly full food menu until 2 am. Smoking allowed. About ¥3,000–6,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 September 2010 (Tabelog). A remodelled townhouse; the small garden behind the counter was designed by Katsuaki Ogawa, son of the 11th-generation Ogawa Jihei (Tabelog). A sister bar, The door Horikawa, is in the Tabelog crawl.

anecdotes.text: On a May 2025 bar crawl, turned away from a famous bar next door, a visitor let the bartender choose single-malt highballs and talked Hanshin baseball with the next customer.
A May 2026 visitor came after the last train for carbonara and a ¥1,600 kiwi cooler — about ¥6,000 for two.
On the first night of an October 2025 weekend in Kyoto, a visitor made it a fourth stop for a martini and a Royal Lochnagar twice up.

cultural_comfort.note: Bar; smoking allowed.

kyoto_bar_rm_gion.hours_raw: MEMBERS ONLY: described as a members-only, invitation-only bar (November 2024; October 2026) — entry by intercom up a narrow stair (March 2024); go with a member or ask about introduction. kyoto_bar_rm_gion.notes: [Members-only cocktail bar · Gion Shirakawa] A six-seat, members-only bar up a narrow stair in a renovated wooden house at the end of a Gion alley — ring the intercom. Go with a member. ¥800 charge; closed Tuesday; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a hidden Gion bar, described in 2024–26 reviews as members-only and invitation-only, in a renovated traditional wooden house; an October 2026 visitor says chefs from across Japan come here.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 visitor was taken by a friend, rang the intercom, climbed the narrow stairs and had time for just two cocktails before a train.
An October 2026 visitor found customers arriving steadily until late and praised bartender Murakami.
A November 2024 visitor tried scotches and brandies never met before.

kyoto_gion_uemori.notes: [Yudofu and yuba kaiseki · Gion] A calm restaurant in a lane just off Hanamikoji, with a small counter downstairs and private rooms up a steep stair, serving reasonably priced kaiseki built on yudofu and yuba — freshly lifted yuba with wasabi, Morika tofu, hiro-usu, tempura, chirimen-sansho rice — at lunch and dinner. Book ahead; no service charge.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese restaurant just off Hanamikoji with counter, tables and four private rooms upstairs; reviewers return for its yudofu and yuba kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 traveller, panicking on a year-end Monday when many places were shut, found it and was surprised by the yuba.
A May 2026 diner on a third visit always orders the yudofu and yuba kaiseki as a meal for a tired body.
An April 2026 guest called the first plate — freshly lifted yuba with fresh wasabi and dashi — the highlight.

UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 25 seats: a 7-seat counter, a sunken-kotatsu room for 2–6 and an upstairs tatami room for 2–16 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). kyoto_kyoryori_oyone.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Ayanokoji, since 1927] A quiet, nearly century-old Kyoto-cuisine restaurant on Ayanokoji near Daimaru, with a counter, a sunken-kotatsu room and an upstairs tatami room, keeping to traditional flavours made by hand — seasonal courses such as matsutake dobin-mushi and hassun. It says it will adapt for dietary restrictions. 10% service (15% in rooms); closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened in December 1927 by the first generation in this area; it keeps to traditional Kyoto flavours with time-honoured, handmade methods while adding new initiatives.
chef_bio.philosophy: Traditional Kyoto flavour, made with care by hand; each guest’s needs met, from celebrations to dietary restrictions (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 business lunch for five felt like a dinner, from crab and matsutake dobin-mushi to chestnut wagashi.

kyoto_gion_juen.notes: [Sukiyaki and shabu-shabu · Gion by Yasaka Shrine, A5 Omi beef] A calm second-floor Wagyu restaurant on the street to Yasaka Shrine, serving A5 Omi beef from a Shiga farm as sukiyaki (from one person at lunch), shabu-shabu or steamed seiro, plus a big hamburg steak and a vegetarian set. Sets from ¥4,980, courses ¥6,600–11,000. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Run by 株式会社ネクスト, registered in the same building (NTA register). The shop’s site describes a Wagyu specialist in Gion. Reviewers say the Omi beef comes direct from a farm in Shiga (April–August 2026) and that the staff cooked the sukiyaki for a group that asked in advance (September 2026).

anecdotes.text: A group of four men in the 70s age bracket, unsure how to cook sukiyaki, asked when booking for staff to cook it, and a staff member did (September 2026).

kyoto_yakitori_no_waraiya.notes: [Yakitori · Tomikoji by Shijo, binchotan and good cheer] A friendly yakitori house a short walk from the Shijo crossing, grilling Kyoto Akadori over binchotan for about 30 years. Six chef’s-choice skewers ¥1,500, plus unusually good vegetable dishes; courses from ¥4,000 with an all-you-can-drink option. A lively manager at the counter; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: The shop says it has grilled yakitori over binchotan for about 30 years, using rare cuts of Kyoto Akadori, with organic and local vegetables (Tabelog). Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a friendly owner and an energetic manager who chats in Kansai dialect at the counter.
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan yakitori with house salt or tare.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner, asked to move from a table to the counter for a group, was given complimentary drinks by the owner.
A March 2026 couple at the counter were chatted to in lively Kansai dialect by the manager, who recommended liver and shiso skewers.
An October 2026 regular calls it a friend’s restaurant, visited on every trip home to Kyoto.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: やきとりの笑い屋、居酒屋・焼鳥、京都市下京区富小路通四条下ル徳正寺42、烏丸駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.フード22:30)、火曜定休、12月31日・1月1日休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー可、お通し350円 (税込)、25席 (カウンター5、テーブル20)、分煙、創業約30年、備長炭でじっくり焼く、京赤地鶏や若鶏の希少部位、独自ブレンドの塩と秘伝のタレ、有機野菜や地元の食材、団体も。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): おまかせ6本盛り1,500円、ホルモン天ぷら680円、お通しにおでん、4,000円のコースと90分飲み放題1,500円、しあわせサラダ、ポテトサラダ、カキフライ、だし巻、唐揚げ、締めのラーメン、元気な店長と関西弁、気さくな店主。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; friendly counter.

kyoto_stand_umineko_koto.gf_detail: Not GF: a craft-beer bar; snacks include spring rolls and kara-age (reviews).
kyoto_stand_umineko_koto.vegan_detail: Ask. Snacks include three kinds of potato salad, spring rolls and octopus with avocado (2026 reviews).
kyoto_stand_umineko_koto.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 16:00–23:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 13:00–23:00; food last order around 21:30; closing days not fixed (Tabelog; March 2026). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). A standing counter for about 10, plus one table at the back; non-smoking (Tabelog; April 2026). Run by Derailleur Brew Works of Nishinari, Osaka, in a renovated townhouse (2026 reviews). Near Shijo Karasuma (Tabelog address; June 2026).
kyoto_stand_umineko_koto.notes: [Craft beer · near Shijo Karasuma, an Osaka brewery's stand] A standing craft-beer bar in a renovated townhouse, run by Nishinari's Derailleur Brew Works: its own Riot Ale and guest taps by the 260 ml glass (¥900), plus cans. Clever snacks — three kinds of potato salad, smoked mentaiko. Opens at 13:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2026) describe a stand run directly by Derailleur Brew Works, a brewery in Nishinari, Osaka, pouring its own beers and guest beers in a renovated Kyoto townhouse; staff explain the difference between house and guest beers.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 second-time visitor made the 21:30 food order just in time for the ethnic potato salad.
An April 2026 traveller changing trains in Kyoto stopped for two small glasses and octopus with avocado.
An October 2026 regular noted the prices had risen since the last visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スタンドうみねこ コト、ビアバー、京都市中京区蛸屋町160-3、月〜金 16:00〜23:00、土日祝 13:00〜23:00、不定休、カード・電子マネー・QR可、立ち飲みカウンター10人ほど、禁煙。口コミ (2026年、英語): 大阪・西成の Derailleur Brew Works の直営、町家を改装、自社と他社のタップ (20〜35)、缶も多い、S (260ml) 900円・M (330ml) 1,200円・L (473ml) 1,700円、西成ライオットエール、ウエストコーストIPA、ポーター、3種のポテトサラダ、燻製明太子、春巻き、唐揚げ、タコとアボカド、フードのL.O.は21:30ごろ、奥にテーブル1つ、値上がり。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing bar; cards accepted; staff explain the beers.

kyoto_sumibi_sakaba_muragon.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal yakitori, oden, sobameshi and yakisoba on the teppan, fried chicken; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_sumibi_sakaba_muragon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori and chicken izakaya (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumibi_sakaba_muragon.hours_raw: 18:00–24:00; closed Tuesday and one irregular day a month (Tabelog). Reservations by phone (October 2024). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a 7–8-seat counter downstairs and tables upstairs for groups; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2025). On Tomikoji south of Ayanokoji (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumibi_sakaba_muragon.notes: [Yakitori · Tomikoji south of Shijo, charcoal and teppan] A small two-floor charcoal yakitori bar opened in 2023: skewers from about ¥250, chicken sashimi, grilled abura-age, and sobameshi sizzling on a teppan, with plenty of sake and awamori. Counter downstairs, tables upstairs; closed Tuesday; open to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Opened in August 2023 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2023–2026) describe a friendly owner-chef who loves food and talk, and an October 2025 reviewer says the owner previously managed another yakitori restaurant before going independent.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor saw the congratulatory gift bags from the opening still on display, near the second anniversary.
A July 2024 regular ordered the chicken sashimi three times.
A July 2026 party was taken there by a classmate of the owner and toasted with Kanemitsu soda.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭火酒場 むらごん、鶏料理・焼鳥・おでん、京都市下京区富小路綾小路下る塗師屋町92-2、火曜定休、月1回不定休、18:00〜24:00、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、20席 (1階カウンター8、2階テーブル)、禁煙、2023年8月10日オープン。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 串5本盛り1,200円 (ハツ、レバー、砂肝、ぼんじり、ささみ)、おでん・椎茸・銀杏・名物の唐揚げ250円、鶏刺し、鶏のたたき、とようけ屋の油揚げの炭火焼き、鉄板のそばめし、焼きそば、豆腐ステーキ、日本酒と泡盛、トマト酢の焼酎ハイボール、気さくな店主、2周年。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; counter downstairs.

kyoto_pontako_sakura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus takoyaki, beef tendon, duck and meat tofu (reviews).
kyoto_pontako_sakura.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Tuesday; hours as updated on 19 August 2026 (Tabelog). Reservations taken during opening hours (Tabelog). Cards, Suica-type e-money and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). ¥300 appetizer charge, even without alcohol (Tabelog; July 2023). 21 seats: a 7-seat counter downstairs; a private room for 6 and two tables upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog). Takoyaki to take away from the front (2018–2026 reviews). In a renovated townhouse on Pontocho next to Pontocho Park, 5 min from Sanjo, Gion-Shijo or Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; January 2026).
kyoto_pontako_sakura.notes: [Takoyaki bar · Pontocho, by the park] A stylish takoyaki and teppan bar in a renovated townhouse by Pontocho Park: small, dashi-rich takoyaki by the four or six with sauce, dashi soy or Andean salt, and wine to match — or two beef-tendon takoyaki to go for ¥300. Counter downstairs, tables upstairs; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2018–2026) describe a takoyaki shop in a renovated Pontocho townhouse with dim lighting and jazz, run by a talkative master, selling takeaway takoyaki at the front and pairing creative takoyaki with wine inside.

anecdotes.text: A September 2022 guest took the master’s advice to add special mayonnaise and Andean pink salt.
A January 2026 passer-by on the way to a gathering was drawn in by the smell and bought two beef-tendon takoyaki for ¥300.
A December 2023 diner had negitoro-topped takoyaki like gunkan sushi, with wine, as in an Italian course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ぽんたこ 佐倉、鉄板焼き・ダイニングバー、京都市中京区先斗町通若松町141-13、京阪祇園四条駅・阪急京都河原町駅・京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、火曜定休 (2026年8月19日から)、予約は営業時間内、カード・交通系電子マネー・PayPay可、お通し300円、21席 (1階カウンター7、2階個室6名・4名テーブル2)、禁煙。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): 町家を改装したおしゃれなたこ焼き屋、先斗町公園の隣、持ち帰り可、4個か6個、だし醤油・塩・マヨネーズ、ダブルチーズ、明太子、ねぎとろのせ、牛すじたこ焼き2個300円、肉豆腐、ポン酢のジュレ、鴨、ワイン、アンデスの塩、話好きのマスター。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; takeaway at the front.

kyoto_konno_yumiyacho.gf_detail: Ask. A Kyoto omakase with dashi, soy and nagaimo somen; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_konno_yumiyacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, crab, eel, chicken and beef courses (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_konno_yumiyacho.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 18:00–23:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, same-day by enquiry; a booking is cancelled if no contact 30 minutes after the time (Tabelog). A seven-dish lunch has been served (December 2025). Service charge 5%, 10% after 21:00 (Tabelog original サービス料5％・21時以降は10％). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Eight counter seats; private hire (Tabelog). Non-smoking; please avoid strong perfume (Tabelog). Children by arrangement (Tabelog). Seasonal hot-pot sets to take home, ordered via the website or Instagram (Tabelog). 7–8 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). Opened 24 April 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_konno_yumiyacho.notes: [Kyoto cuisine with wine · Yamatooji-Matsubara, 8 seats] A quiet eight-seat counter, opened in 2025 near Miyagawa-cho, where a chef trained at Gion's Hassun cooks classical Kyoto dishes to go with wine — some ten by the glass and champagne from magnums — and the owner, once a Gion Kobu geiko, hosts. Service charge rises from 5% to 10% after 9 p.m. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a quiet Japanese restaurant of eight counter seats opened 24 April 2025, with wines, Kyoto and Yamagata sake and magnum champagne by the glass chosen by a sommelier owner, and hospitality from the owner, once a geiko in Gion Kobu. Reviewers in October 2025 and August 2026 say the chef trained at Hassun in Gion; an April 2026 reviewer says the chef holds a sommelier certificate.
chef_bio.philosophy: Classical Japanese food paired with wine (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 solo lunch guest started with a warming chawanmushi instead of cold starters, then koppe crab peeled for the guest, with champagne from a magnum.
An April 2026 private party had a spring course built on flower sansho — eel, chicken shabu-shabu in sansho broth — after sea urchin, firefly squid and abalone.
An August 2026 diner found the cooking traditional and dashi-led, ingredients allowed to speak, at a comfortable distance from the chef.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区大和大路通松原下る弓矢町38、清水五条駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩7〜8分、火〜日 18:00〜23:00、月曜休み、予約可 (当日も相談可、30分連絡なしはキャンセル扱い)、サービス料5% (21時以降は10%)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター8席、貸切可、禁煙、香水など強い香りは控えて、子どもは相談、季節の鍋セットの販売 (公式サイト・Instagram)、2025年4月24日開店、宮川町と祇園の近くの静かな日本料理店、ソムリエの店主が選ぶグラスワイン約10種、京都と山形の日本酒、マグナムのグラスシャンパン、祇園甲部の元芸妓の店主のもてなし。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 料理人は祇園の Hassun で修業 (2025年10月、2026年8月)、料理人はソムリエの資格も (2026年4月)、7品の昼 (2025年12月)、茶碗蒸し、こっぺ蟹、選べる果物のデザート、山椒の春のコース (雲丹、ほたるいか、鮑、蛤の椀、鰻、山椒のだしの鶏しゃぶ)、長芋そうめん、八寸、鱧の造り、牛肉の主菜。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter of eight; no strong perfume; service 5%, 10% after 21:00; cards.

kyoto_sauna_izakaya_sanjo.gf_detail: Not GF: pasta, terrine and cheesecake on the menu (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sauna_izakaya_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu bolognese, salmon cream pasta and liver pudding (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sauna_izakaya_sanjo.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Friday 17:00–23:00; Saturday 15:00–23:00; Sunday 15:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — often full (Tabelog; February 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Counter seats downstairs and more on upper floors, three levels in all; private hire (Tabelog; February 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Weak phone signal inside (January 2026). Just north of Kawaramachi-Sanjo; about 190 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 19 May 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sauna_izakaya_sanjo.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi-Sanjo, sauna-themed] A playful three-floor izakaya dressed as a sauna — wood panelling, sauna hats, lockers — from the team behind OFURO: pretty, wine-friendly plates like liver pudding, taro-and-sansho terrine and wagyu bolognese, with house cocktails. Friendly staff; book ahead. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: the sister restaurant of OFURO (kyoto_ofuro_sanjo), sharing some staff, styled like a sauna and public bath though there is no actual sauna, on three floors with counter seating (November 2025–October 2026). Opened 19 May 2023 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 OFURO regular finally tried the iced cheesecake — crunchy half-frozen, creamy as it warms — and found some of the same friendly staff.
A January 2026 diner at the counter loved a sake-and-Calpis cocktail but got no phone signal for two hours — fine for a digital detox.
A November 2025 visitor, after a massage, enjoyed the sauna hats and locker-style decor of a sauna without the sauna.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、中京区恵比須町534-33、京都市役所前駅から185m、月・水〜金 17:00〜23:00、土 15:00〜23:00、日 15:00〜22:00、火曜休み、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、貸切可、禁煙、2023年5月19日開店。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): OFURO の姉妹店 (スタッフも一部共通)、サウナや銭湯をイメージした木の内装、サウナハットやロッカー、3階建てでカウンター中心、前菜の盛り合わせ、ポテトサラダ、椎茸のマリネ、里芋と山椒のテリーヌ、大人のレバープリン、きのこのムース、和牛のボロネーゼ、鮭ときのこのクリームパスタ、アイスチーズケーキ、ワイン、ハイボール、緑茶ハイ、日本酒のカルピス割り、予約がおすすめ、店内は電波が弱い (2026年1月)、5品と2杯で4,000円ほど (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; weak phone signal; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_sushi_nao_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Edo-style sushi with soy and simmered clam; no gluten information (2008–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_nao_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi counter (2008–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_nao_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–2:00; closed Sunday and holiday Mondays; hours may change (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). About six to eight counter seats and a small table at the back; no photos (2008–2011 reviews). Gion Shinbashi, a short walk east of Hanamikoji (2008–2011 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_nao_gion.notes: [Sushi · Gion Shinbashi, late] A tiny, long-running Gion sushi counter open until 2 a.m., where you order from the day's fish laid out in a wooden box — flounder, chu-toro, swordfish — rather than a fixed course. Regulars rave about the fish and the rice-to-topping balance; others found the service curt. No photos. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a small Edo-style sushi counter just east of Hanamikoji in Gion Shinbashi, reviewed since 2008, run in 2008 by the chef with one woman assisting; known for buying fine fish (2008–2019 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An October 2008 visitor praised the choice of fish — flounder, chu-toro and swordfish — over a glass of Cristal, and noted there was no set course.
An April 2019 regular called the rice-to-fish balance perfect and the fish unmatched anywhere else.
A February 2020 guest found the service unpleasant and would not return.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、東山区橋本町403、三条京阪から415m、月〜土 18:00〜翌2:00、日曜休み、祝日の月曜休み、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可。口コミ (2008年1月〜2026年6月、英語): 祇園新橋の花見小路の少し東、カウンター6〜8席と奥に小さなテーブル、写真は控えるよう頼まれる (2011年)、その日の魚を木箱に並べる、コースでなく好みで、平目、中とろ、かじき、煮蛤、納豆巻き、シャンパン、店主と女性一人 (2008年)、魚とシャリの釣り合いがよい (2019年4月)、接客が不快だったとの声 (2020年2月)、高いが価値ある握り (2026年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter of regulars; no photos; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews in January 2025 and June 2026.

kyoto_bar_bunkyu.gf_detail: A cocktail and whisky bar with no food described; spirits like whisky are generally gluten-free — ask about beer and mixers (2013–2025 reviews).
kyoto_bar_bunkyu.vegan_detail: Drinks only — cocktails of seasonal fruit and Scotch (2015–2018 reviews).
kyoto_bar_bunkyu.hours_raw: Tuesday, Friday and Saturday 20:00–24:00; closed other days; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards (Tabelog). About seven to nine seats around one large wooden table; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; 2015 reviews). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Very dark inside (2013–2025 reviews). At the end of a narrow alley off the street north of Kawaramachi-Sanjo, behind a noren reading "bar Bunkyu" (2013–2025 reviews).
kyoto_bar_bunkyu.notes: [Bar · Kawaramachi-Sanjo alley, Tue/Fri/Sat] A near-dark bar inside an old storehouse at the end of a narrow alley: one big rounded wooden table, a bartender mixing cocktails from seasonal fruit to suit you, and Scotch. Look for the "bar Bunkyu" noren. Open three nights a week from 8 p.m.; cash only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a bar in a storehouse a December 2013 reviewer dates to the first year of the Bunkyu era, once used by a flower shop; a February 2018 reviewer says it is produced by the Kyoto florist Hanamasa, with a bartender, Nao, who makes cocktails from seasonal fruit and world spirits. A March 2015 guest saw foreign guests looked after in fluent English.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 traveller, emboldened by a few drinks, followed a noren reading only "bar Bunkyu" down a narrow alley to a small door.
A March 2015 guest found it so dark the eyes needed time to adjust to the rounded wooden table, and was seen to the door after two Scotches.
An October 2019 reviewer liked the dark, small room and reasonable drinks but felt the bartender chooses customers.

An August 2026 lunch diner (review in Japanese) found the plate system confusing but the small nigiri very good.

kyoto_royal_1382_sakaimachi.notes: [Café · Sakaimachi, antiques and flowers] A storybook café filled with antique furniture and flowers, where you choose an antique plate, pick scones, cookies or cakes, and sit with a flavoured tea — try the an-butter scone, filled to order. The chatty owner sometimes reads tarot in the evening. Cashless only; closed Thursday. Flagged: a sister of a bakery in Otsu.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer calls the shop a sister of Bakery Ranunculus in Otsu, Shiga. Reviewers describe a friendly, talkative owner (April, August and October 2026); one notes that the cream-puff range of the early days has given way to baked goods, scones and cassata (March 2026).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor reports that the owner whimsically offers tarot card readings in the evening.
A September 2026 visitor came twice during a four-day stay in Kyoto.

kyoto_ariyoshi_sushi_gion.notes: [Sushi · Gion alley, small plates then nigiri] A hidden sushi counter down a narrow Gion alley, where a warm, playful chef serves about ten seasonal small plates — firefly squid, moroko, fried anago — then nigiri chosen to taste, at clear, fair prices. Lunch and dinner; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a friendly head chef with a big personality who keeps guests entertained (June 2025, September 2026) and prices that are clear and reasonable (April 2025).

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner watched the chef drink from a giant wine glass holding two litres of sake — apparently a signature act.
A March 2026 first-timer, sent by a gourmet friend, liked that the course does not start until a drink is ordered.

kyoto_gion_shinbashi_kawakatsu.notes: [Beef dining · Gion Shinbashi, a counter behind an iron door] A small counter hidden behind an iron door, with a blackboard of beef dishes ordered à la carte and plated per person — su-gyu sweet-and-sour beef, tripe with ponzu, beef shabu-shabu, menchi katsu — and dan dan noodles or oxtail ramen to finish. chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe an owner whose care for the meat shows in the seasoning and plating (January 2026) and who is good company across the counter (August 2026).

kyoto_lamb_room_takakura.notes: [Lamb Genghis Khan · Takakura-Bukkoji] A tiny, neon-lit counter near Shijo-Karasuma serving never-frozen lamb for Genghis Khan, cut to order and grilled on individual domed pans over bean sprouts and onion — a ¥1,980 set for one, lamb chops and shoulder roll to add, and garlic-chive yakisoba or lamb curry to finish. Mild enough for first-timers; a chatty master. Book ahead.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Genghis Khan restaurant serving fresh lamb that has never been frozen, mild enough for first-timers.

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 diner tried lamb with salt for the first time and talked horse racing with the master.
An April 2026 regular notes the owner seems pleased when guests add an egg to the yakisoba.
A July 2026 regular finds summer the easiest time to book, since grilling at the table is hot work.

kyoto_steak_paul_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an Omi beef steakhouse (2023–26 reviews).

kyoto_steak_paul_gion.notes: [Omi beef steakhouse · Hanamikoji, about 70 years] A dim, Showa-era steakhouse on Hanamikoji run by an elderly couple, with a small rock garden behind glass, serving A5 Omi beef tenderloin — first as sweet beef sashimi with mustard soy, then as steak, teriyaki or pepper-grilled. chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a long-established Gion steakhouse, said to be about 70 years old in February 2026, run by an elderly couple and serving Omi beef from Maruki Shoten.
chef_bio.specialty: A5 Omi beef tenderloin; beef sashimi.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner noted the proprietress’s calm manner as distinctly Kyoto.
A December 2025 regular says the raw beef looks doubtful at first glance but is delicious, and leaves feeling satisfied every time.
A February 2026 visitor praised the couple’s warm service and its Gion-style sense of distance.

kyoto_chabuya_takakura.notes: [Charcoal yakitori · Takakura-Bukkoji, since 2010] A busy yakitori house in a townhouse off Takakura-dori near Shijo-Karasuma, with big skewers — liver, skin, soft-bone tsukune, salted neck — oden in winter, blackboard sakes, and a sweet fried-bread finish. chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the sister shop of the original 炭火焼鳥 ちゃぶや (which closed in March 2021), part of the ちゃぶ家グループ of about six Kyoto shops. Opened October 2010 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal yakitori; fried bread to finish.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 diner ordered the fried bread out of curiosity and wanted a second one at once.
A March 2026 visitor arrived at 18:00 on a weekday to find it already fully booked, and called the grilling perfect.

kyoto_kana_nobuko_gion.notes: [Negiyaki and okonomiyaki · Hanamikoji, late] A tiny, snack-bar-looking counter in an alley beside the Lawson on Hanamikoji, where an older proprietress cooks almost single-handedly until 1:00 — negiyaki (the chikuwa one is the house pick), fluffy dashimaki, okonomiyaki, yakisoba and red sausage — helped along by regulars. chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a long-running counter okonomiyaki shop in Gion known for negiyaki; a March 2020 reviewer heard it is loosely related to 祇園ねぎ焼 かな but under different management.

A March 2026 returnee after the pandemic years could not resist the red sausage.

kyoto_gahojin_kappa_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi, sashimi, robata-grilled fish, dashimaki and many fried dishes; no gluten information is published (official menu; reviews).
kyoto_gahojin_kappa_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and sushi izakaya. Simple vegetable dishes (tomato or onion slices, spinach ohitashi, daikon salad) are listed — ask (official menu).
kyoto_gahojin_kappa_gion.hours_raw: Weekdays 18:00–02:00 (last entry 02:00); Sunday and holidays 17:00–24:00; closed Monday (official site, November 2026) — the site lists only weekday and Sunday-and-holiday hours, so no Saturday hours are given — check before going on a Saturday. Reservations by phone; groups up to 30; English menu (official site; Tabelog). Cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners only (Tabelog; August 2026). Smoking allowed, paper cigarettes included (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Counter on the ground floor, tatami upstairs (2026 reviews). Busy and popular with foreign visitors; walk-ins may wait (2026 reviews). On the corner of Yamato-oji and Sueyoshi-cho in northern Gion, 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_gahojin_kappa_gion.notes: [Izakaya · northern Gion, sushi and robata till 2 am] A busy two-floor izakaya on Yamato-oji serving sushi, robata-grilled fish and good fried dishes until the small hours — reasonable for Gion, with nigiri from ¥550 a pair and a famous dashimaki. Counter downstairs, tatami up; smoking allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Run by きりんやフーズ, a group centred on Gion, Kyoto, that buys at the market every morning (official site); its site lists a few other shops of its own.
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh seafood, meat, vegetables and dried goods bought at the market each morning or sent direct from the producers (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi and dashimaki late into the night.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 solo diner waited 30 minutes without a booking, then had sashimi, dashimaki, robata-grilled sanma and hamo tempura.
A July 2026 regular calls the mentaiko dashimaki the best tamagoyaki tried anywhere; the shrimp are kept live in a tank.
An August 2026 guest advises naming an accepted card brand clearly, as staff first said cards were not taken.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (きりんやフーズ): 我逢人かっぱ、京都市東山区八坂新地末吉町77、平日18:00〜翌2:00 (入店ラスト2:00)、日祝17:00〜24:00、月曜定休、宴会は最大30名、ふぐコース。きりんやフーズは京都・祇園を中心に飲食店を展開、毎朝市場で仕入れ、産地直送。メニュー: 握り2カン550〜770円 (とろ770円)、細巻530〜770円、盛り合せ並1,980円・上2,590円、だしまき480円、明太子だしまき550円、うまき1,080円、鯛かぶと焼1,080円、さわら西京焼880円、なす田楽・生麩田楽880円、とりからあげ550円、牛たたき2,180円。食べログ: 寿司・居酒屋・日本料理、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、カード (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、喫煙可、英語メニュー。口コミ (2026年、英語): 大和大路と末吉町の角、1階カウンター、2階座敷、外国からの客が多い、遅くまで開いている、刺身5種盛り、炉端の秋刀魚、鱧の天ぷら、生簀の海老、飲み物500円、紙巻きたばこも可。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; many foreign guests; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Official site (November 2026 closing days) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kantaku_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, tempura, braised pork belly, seafood hot pot with soba to finish; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_kantaku_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and meat izakaya (reviews).
kyoto_kantaku_kiyamachi.hours_raw: 19:00–07:00 daily (last order 06:30); open all year (Tabelog). Reservations taken, same day by phone (Tabelog; February 2023). Cards accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog’s English note mentions one, but the Japanese original says none — ask. 27 seats: 5 at the counter, 22 at tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog). All-you-can-eat and drink plans (Tabelog). On the ground floor of the Grantac Rokkaku Building near Kiyamachi, 5 min from Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; April 2024).
kyoto_kantaku_kiyamachi.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi, seafood until 7 am] A rare all-night izakaya near Kiyamachi, open from 19:00 to 7:00: sashimi platters, charcoal-grilled milt, braised pork belly and a seafood hot-pot course, with walls of shochu. Useful for a late second round or breakfast after a long night. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2023–2026) describe a seafood-focused izakaya near Kiyamachi that stays open until 7 am, with a wide shochu collection lining the walls.
chef_bio.specialty: Late-night sashimi and seafood hot pot.

anecdotes.text: An April 2024 second-rounder found fresh firefly squid in the sashimi at midnight.
A March 2023 visitor searching for food late at night found it and loved the garlic sprouts and braised pork belly.
An October 2026 guest came at dawn after drinking all night in Kiyamachi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: かんたく、居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、京都市中京区北車屋町265 グランタック六角ビル1F、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、毎日19:00〜翌7:00 (L.O.6:30)、年中無休、予約可、カード可、電子マネー不可、27席 (カウンター5、テーブル22)、喫煙可、飲み放題・食べ放題あり、サービス料の記載は英語と日本語で食い違う。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 朝7時まで開いている、刺身盛り合わせ (カンパチ、鯛、サーモン、帆立、ホタルイカ)、白子の炭火焼き、豚の角煮、あさりのグラタン、にんにくの芽、しらすおろし、豚キムチ、だし巻、天ぷら盛り合わせ、海老マヨ、海鮮鍋のコースと締めのそば、焼酎の品ぞろえ、飲み放題付きで1人5,000円以下 (2023年)。

cultural_comfort.note: Open all night; cards accepted; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_cafe_baw_nishiki.gf_detail: Not GF: croffles are made from croissant dough; donuts and brownies too (reviews).
kyoto_cafe_baw_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter-rich croissant dough, custard and cream (reviews).
kyoto_cafe_baw_nishiki.hours_raw: 10:30–18:00 daily; closed over New Year (Tabelog). Order and pay first at the counter, then collect with a buzzer; mostly self-service (2024 reviews). Cards (Visa, Master) and e-money accepted (Tabelog). 34 seats; non-smoking; power outlets (Tabelog). Dogs welcome inside (2024–2025 reviews). Stairs up to the café — awkward with prams (September 2024). On the 2nd floor in Nishiki Market, 4 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_cafe_baw_nishiki.notes: [Café · Nishiki Market, a black-and-white croffle room] Up a flight of stairs above Nishiki Market, a café drawn entirely in black-and-white line art, like stepping into a comic. Freshly fried croffles (honey butter about ¥1,200), cream sodas and tea; order at the counter and wait for the buzzer. Dogs welcome.

chef_bio.background: Opened in December 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2024–2026) describe Kyoto’s first "2D art café", with monochrome walls and furniture, specialising in croffles from French croissant dough and tea.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 visitor brought a dog, Pom, who modelled for photos; staff lent a top for the owner.
A December 2024 guest took dozens of photos while waiting for a freshly fried croffle.
A March 2026 visitor, worn out by the crowds of Nishiki, found the quiet black-and-white room a different world.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ バウ、カフェ・洋菓子、京都市中京区東魚屋町180 2F、京都河原町駅から徒歩4分、10:30〜18:00、年末年始休み、カード (VISA・Master)・電子マネー可、34席、禁煙、電源あり、2022年12月9日オープン、絵本の中のような2Dアートカフェ、紅茶とクロッフル。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 錦市場の2階、モノクロの店内、京都初のクロッフルと紅茶の専門店、フランス産のクロワッサン生地、ハニーバタークロッフル1,200円、アイスコーヒーとのセット1,500円、アフタヌーンティーのスタンド、クリームソーダ、バタフライピーのレモネード、先払いでブザーで呼ばれる、セルフサービス、犬同伴可、入口に階段、外国からの客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter ordering; many foreign visitors; dogs welcome.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026. The website on Tabelog (cafebaw.com) now shows unrelated gambling content, so it is left out.

kyoto_soma_kamogawa.gf_detail: Ask. Handmade Italian: carpaccio, roast beef, grilled meats, pasta and pizza; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_soma_kamogawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Italian dishes of meat, fish and cheese (reviews).
kyoto_soma_kamogawa.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 daily; closing days irregular — check social media (Tabelog). Reservations recommended for riverside seats in summer (July 2026). Cards and e-money accepted (Tabelog). 10% service charge since 1 October 2024 (Tabelog). 50 seats with a 10-seat counter; a terrace and summer kawadoko over the Kamo River; designated smoking space (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Christmas Eve and Day: a ¥10,000 set course only (Tabelog). On the Kamo River near Shimizu-Gojo (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_soma_kamogawa.notes: [Italian · Kamo River by Gojo, a riverside terrace] A relaxed Italian restaurant and bar with a terrace and summer kawadoko over the Kamo near Gojo: carpaccio, roast beef, grilled lamb, pizzas and seasonal pasta, with courses and free-flow drinks from about ¥7,000. Open to midnight; 10% service; book river seats early.

chef_bio.background: Opened in August 2023 (Tabelog); run by 株式会社love letters of Higashiyama, Kyoto (National Tax Agency invoice register T3130001064433). The shop offers handmade Italian with seasonal ingredients by the Kamo River (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Handmade Italian with seasonal ingredients all year round (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Italian courses on the Kamo River kawadoko.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 couple booked the kawadoko course the day before, but the riverside seats were already full even on a weekday.
An October 2026 diner happened to catch a drone show over the river during dinner.
A September 2026 table by the river tried conger eel and matsutake pasta, a taste of early autumn.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: SOMA、イタリアン・バー、京都市下京区美濃屋町177、毎日17:00〜24:00、不定休 (SNSで確認)、カード・電子マネー可、2024年10月1日からサービス料10%、50席 (カウンター10)、喫煙スペースあり、2023年8月4日オープン、鴨川沿いのイタリアンとバー、季節の食材の手作りイタリアン、12月24・25日はクリスマス限定コース10,000円のみ、インボイス T3130001064433 (株式会社love letters、京都市東山区)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 清水五条の鴨川沿い、テラスと川床、ラムのグリル2,550円、ディアボラ2,650円、前菜3種1,350円、フライドポテト780円、ハウスワイン950円、ライムモヒート1,580円、カルパッチョ、ハラミのローストビーフ、タコのアヒージョ、和牛ステーキ、鱧と松茸のパスタ、カタラーナ、川床コース飲み放題付き7,000円、8,000円のコース、ハイネケン、京都のクラフトビール。

cultural_comfort.note: Cards accepted; 10% service; riverside terrace.

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; reviews dated May–October 2026.

kyoto_gion_gozu_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Puddings (custard and caramel) may be wheat-free, but éclairs and cakes are not; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_gozu_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg-and-milk puddings, cream éclairs, soft serve (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_gozu_shijo.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 13:00–22:00; Saturday and Sunday 11:00–22:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Late in the evening it may be take-away only (June 2025). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Popular flavours sell out by evening (April 2023; February 2026). 1F of APA Hotel Kyoto Gion Excellent, by the Shijo end of Gion (Tabelog; May 2025).
kyoto_gion_gozu_shijo.notes: [Pudding shop · Gion, open late] A small Gion sweets shop on the ground floor of a hotel, open until 10 p.m., known for very soft puddings with a bitter caramel — plain, matcha, hojicha, black sesame, Earl Grey, sakura in spring — plus éclairs and matcha soft serve. Eat in or take away; flavours sell out at night.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: GION GOZU is a Western-style confectionery shop; this is its Shijo shop, with a main shop listed separately. Reviewers since 2023 describe a pudding and éclair specialist open late in Gion.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 visitor, back for more after a black-sesame pudding, ate the spring sakura pudding in the shop — custard below, pink sakura jelly on top.
A June 2025 guest arriving around 21:00 found eat-in had finished and took away a matcha pudding instead.
A May 2025 traveller staying at the hotel next door came down at night for a matcha soft serve.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スイーツ (洋菓子)、東山区祇園町南側555 アパホテル京都祇園excellent 1F、月〜金 13:00〜22:00、土・日 11:00〜22:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、洋菓子店。口コミ (2023年4月〜2026年2月、英語): プリンとエクレアの専門店、やわらかいプリンと少し苦いカラメル (プレーン、チョコ、抹茶、ほうじ茶、黒ごま、アールグレイ、季節の桜とゼリー)、マンゴーとクリームのエクレア、チョコケーキ、抹茶ソフト、夜は売り切れる味も、21時ごろは店内飲食不可で持ち帰りのみだった (2025年6月)、隣のホテルに泊まった客 (2025年5月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter sweets shop; eat in or take away; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through February 2026.

kyoto_gion_nakahana.gf_detail: Not GF: fried fugu (karaage) is part of the standard course, with ponzu and soy throughout (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_gion_nakahana.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fugu, hamo and wagyu courses (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_nakahana.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); lunch by phone reservation only; closing days irregular; closed 30 December–1 January (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog original サービス料10%). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money (IC, iD, QUICPay) and QR (PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay) (Tabelog). 30 seats; private rooms for 2 to 20 (Tabelog; February 2022). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Gion south side, a little off the main streets; 10 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; February 2024).
kyoto_gion_nakahana.notes: [Fugu and Kyoto courses · Gion south side] A friendly, couple-run Gion restaurant with private rooms, best known for fair-priced fugu courses — sashimi, grilled and fried fugu, hot pot ending in zosui — and seasonal hamo and matsutake later in the year. Lunch by phone booking only. 10% service; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a Gion restaurant run by a kind couple (February 2025), known for fugu. A March 2024 reviewer, introduced by an old friend of the head chef, learned that the chef's wife is the daughter of the owner of Monk's, a place the reviewer used to frequent.

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 guest discovered the head chef is married to the daughter of the owner of Monk’s, a place the guest once frequented.
A February 2025 diner on the fugu-and-meat course watched the hot pot taken to the kitchen and brought back as zosui with extra fugu.
A January 2026 family New Year party added grilled soft roe to the tecchiri course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、東山区祇園町南側570-190、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩10分、祇園バス停から徒歩5分、毎日 12:00〜14:30 (L.O.14:00)、17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、昼は電話予約のみ、不定休、12月30日〜1月1日休み、サービス料10%、カード・電子マネー (交通系IC・iD・QUICPay)・QR (PayPay・d払い・楽天ペイ・au PAY・Alipay・WeChat Pay) 可、30席、個室 (2〜20名)、喫煙可、公式サイトあり。口コミ (2022年2月〜2026年10月、英語): ふぐのコース約11,500円 (前菜5種、てっぴ、てっさ、焼きふぐ、唐揚げ、てっちり、雑炊)、焼き白子2,500円、ひれ酒、ふぐと和牛のコース、秋の鱧のコース (生湯葉、鱧の造り、焼き鱧、松茸の土瓶蒸し)、夫婦で営む (2025年2月)、料理長の妻は Monk's の店主の娘 (2024年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Private rooms; lunch by phone booking; 10% service; smoking allowed; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_obatarian_gion.gf_detail: Not GF: pasta, pizza, gratin and fried chicken (2020–2026 reviews).
kyoto_obatarian_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: obanzai with dashi, oysters, hamburg steak, bacon (2020–2026 reviews).
kyoto_obatarian_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 19:00–5:00 (last order 4:00); closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted up to two days ahead; private bookings for 5–10 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Ten counter seats; a private room for 5–10 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). At the back of the Yuuki building on the north side of Gion, easy to miss; 6 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; February 2022).
kyoto_obatarian_gion.notes: [Obanzai and Italian · Gion north side, till 5 a.m.] A ten-seat counter hidden at the back of a Gion building, where an Okinawa-born owner sets out big bowls of obanzai beside pizza and pasta — the "gout pasta" and broccoli aglio e olio are favourites — for Gion's after-hours crowd until 5 a.m. Smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a late-night Gion restaurant blending obanzai and Italian cooking, popular with people from the restaurant trade after work (September 2024); an April 2026 reviewer describes the warm hospitality of the owner, from Okinawa, and obanzai made with local ingredients.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 regular praised the Okinawan owner's warmth and the endless goya and broccoli obanzai, then the luxurious gout pasta.
A December 2023 fan often eats two portions of the broccoli aglio e olio alone, and finally got to try the kasujiru.
A May 2023 guest arrived late after drinks and caught the last fresh oyster of the night.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・日本料理・ワインバー、東山区祇園町北側347-31 ユウキビル 1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩6分、月〜土 19:00〜翌5:00 (L.O.4:00)、日・祝休み、予約は2日前まで、5〜10名で貸切可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター10席、個室 (5〜10名)、喫煙可。口コミ (2020年5月〜2026年7月、英語): ビルの奥で見つけにくい、カウンターに大鉢のおばんざい、おばんざいとイタリアン、沖縄出身の店主 (2026年4月)、ゴーヤやブロッコリーのおばんざい、ブロッコリーのアーリオオーリオ、「gout pasta」、ピザ、カルパッチョ、バーニャカウダ、グラタン、唐揚げ、おでん、ハンバーグ、生牡蠣、冬の粕汁、飲食店の人が多い (2024年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Late-night counter; book up to two days ahead; smoking allowed; cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through July 2026.

kyoto_intero_panya_nishiki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bakery of wheat breads, tartines and doughnuts (2026 reviews).
kyoto_intero_panya_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: croissants, cream doughnuts, cheese breads (2026 reviews).
kyoto_intero_panya_nishiki.hours_raw: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun 08:00–17:00; closed Thursdays; hours may change (Tabelog). No bookings (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). A small standing eat-in space (August 2026 review). On Takakura just north of Nishiki Market, 3 min from Karasuma (Tabelog; July 2026 review).
kyoto_intero_panya_nishiki.notes: [Bakery · Nishiki Market] A long, clean bakery by the Takakura end of Nishiki Market: 30 cm tartines, buttery croissants, cream-filled doughnuts and ¥100 "treasure bread" from the day before. Takeaway, with a little standing room. About ¥300–2,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 13 January 2026 (Tabelog). Sells the previous day's bread as "treasure bread" to reduce food waste (May 2026 review). Instagram @interopanya (July 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Reducing food waste with day-old "treasure bread" (May 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor came for the famous tartines, over 30 cm long, and liked the light fresh doughnuts too.
An August 2026 first-timer at opening found no names or prices on the shelves and waited five minutes for the staff.
An October 2026 visitor praised the croissant's fine, crackling layers, still good after the trip home.

cultural_comfort.note: Self-service bakery; shelves may lack labels (August 2026 review).

kyoto_gohandoko_tsukikage.gf_detail: Ask. Dashi-based Kyoto dishes with fried items, gyoza and croquettes; soy and miso throughout (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gohandoko_tsukikage.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, duck, wagyu, turtle, hamo and dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gohandoko_tsukikage.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Sundays (Tabelog). Bookings taken; same-day and private-room (course only) bookings by phone (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「なし」; the English translation wrongly says one applies). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 12 seats: 8 at the counter, a private room for 4; smoking area; children welcome; BYO drinks (Tabelog). By the Takase River, about 5 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo exit 3 (Tabelog; April 2026 review).
kyoto_gohandoko_tsukikage.notes: [Kyoto kappo · Takase River] A new white-wood counter by the Takase River near Gojo serving Kyoto kappo à la carte or as a course — hamo, Kamo aubergine, turtle, and freshly cooked rice with jako to finish. About ¥10,000–15,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 February 2026 (Tabelog). An April 2026 reviewer says it is run by the same people as Nakahigashi and Yamakishi. An October 2026 diner describes it as run by a young couple.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto kappo à la carte; donabe rice.

anecdotes.text: A diner at the pre-opening in February 2026 noted power outlets under the counter and ordered freely from the à la carte list.
A July 2026 diner's favourite was hamo grilled with a Naruto-negi sauce, then Kamo aubergine with sea urchin and wagyu.
An October 2026 diner ordered turtle hot pot for one; the zosui came early, as the third dish.
Another October 2026 course diner found it average for the price and the regulars loud.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ごはん處 月かげ、日本料理・魚介料理、下京区難波町420-8、清水五条駅から徒歩6分、月〜土・祝 17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、日曜休み、予約可 (当日・個室は電話、個室はコースのみ)、サービス料「なし」、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、12席 (カウンター8、4人用の個室)、喫煙所、子ども可、持ち込み可、2026年2月23日オープン。口コミ (2026年、英語): アラカルトとコース、鯛の昆布締め、鰆、鴨、ふきのとうの天ぷら、すっぽんのスープ、和牛と筍、穴子、ふきのとうのクリームコロッケ、炊きたてのご飯とちりめんじゃこと赤だし、鱧の白醤油焼き、Kamo なすと雲丹と和牛、土鍋ご飯、Nakahigashi と Yamakishi と同じ人たちの店 (2026年4月)、若い夫婦 (2026年10月)。

kyoto_nihonshuya_shuroku.gf_detail: Ask. Oden broth, miso-grilled rice balls and the ramen to finish are soy, miso or wheat-based (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nihonshuya_shuroku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi, sashimi, steamed sea-bream head (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nihonshuya_shuroku.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 18:00–24:00; Sat and Sun 15:00–17:30 and 18:00–24:00; closed Mondays; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 counter seats; non-smoking, smoking area; restroom outside (Tabelog; November 2024 and February 2025 reviews). In the Momiji no Koji courtyard of a renovated townhouse off Gokomachi–Matsubara, 8 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo (Tabelog; January 2025 review).
kyoto_nihonshuya_shuroku.notes: [Sake bar & oden · Matsubara] An eleven-seat counter in a townhouse courtyard off Matsubara, built around a cellar of sake served at just the right warmth, with oden and generous small plates. About ¥4,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 July 2021 (Tabelog). A sake cellar of isshobin at the back (January 2025 and January 2026 reviews). The illustration on the sign was drawn by the owner's wife (February 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: A place to enjoy Japanese sake, with house notes for customers (January 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 warm-sake fan described a taste, received recommendations, and found every cup at exactly the right temperature.
A March 2026 visitor asked for the best sake for warming and was impressed by the range.
A neighbour (August 2026) finally came in for oden with shuto butter, octopus sashimi and ramen to finish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: にほんしゅ屋 しゅうろく、日本酒バー・おでん、下京区御幸町通り松原西入ル石不動之町682-3 もみじの小路H-7、京都河原町駅から徒歩10分・清水五条駅から徒歩8分、火〜金 18:00〜24:00、土日 15:00〜17:30・18:00〜24:00、月曜休み、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンター11席、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、2021年7月1日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 一升瓶の並ぶ酒蔵、燗酒と冷酒、Maibijin、Yuki no Bosha、Akika など、Eiko Fuji 770円、Furosen 660円、Ippongi 725円、おでん、Ishigaki daiのお造り、鯛のかぶとの酒蒸し、shuto バターのおでん、たこのお造り、締めのラーメン、麦味噌の焼きおにぎり、看板の絵は店主の奥さん (2025年2月)、トイレは外。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter sake bar; staff recommend sake by taste.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_koimariya_takakura.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and grilled fish may suit, but tempura and seasoned dishes are not (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_koimariya_takakura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, grilled fish, Kyoto chicken, beef steak (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_koimariya_takakura.hours_raw: Daily 17:30–23:30; irregular closures; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken; courses such as ¥4,500 and all-you-can-drink local sake (2025 reviews). Cover charge ¥380 before tax (Tabelog Japanese original 「税別380円」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter on the 1st floor and rooms upstairs; smoking allowed (Tabelog; April 2026 review). On Takakura south of Shijo, near Daimaru, 4 min from Karasuma (Tabelog; April 2026 review).
kyoto_koimariya_takakura.notes: [Sake bar & kappo · Takakura] A narrow counter (and rooms upstairs) on Takakura near Daimaru, run by one owner who cooks seasonal kappo — sashimi, hamo, ayu tempura, grilled fish — to go with a good list of sake. About ¥4,000–9,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 July 2015 (Tabelog). The owner runs everything alone, pacing dishes to each group (June 2025 review); busier lately with larger groups upstairs (April 2026 review). Tabelog notes its map pin cannot be corrected by the shop.

anecdotes.text: A couple who rarely drink took the ¥4,500 course in June 2025 and enjoyed the owner's gentle conversation, timed to each table.
A diner back in June 2026 for the first time since June 2020 left the order to the owner, starting with a sashimi platter.
An April 2026 first-timer, brought by colleagues, discovered the deep-sea fish mejikari, fried.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: こいまりや、日本酒バー・居酒屋、下京区高倉通綾小路下ル竹屋町388-5 高倉ビル1F・2F、烏丸駅から264m、毎日 17:30〜23:30 (不定休)、予約可、チャージ税別380円、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、個室、喫煙可、2015年7月1日オープン、地図の位置を直せないとの店の注記。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 店主が一人で切り盛り、4,500円のコース (京都の鶏の焼き物、鱧、鮎)、鮎と山菜の天ぷら、焼き魚、牛のステーキ、とろろとまぐろの漬け丼、鰻と夏野菜の椀、mejikariの唐揚げ、刺身5種盛り、Lake Biwa の稚鮎の天ぷら、紅鮭の茶漬け、Mansaku・Eikun・Hoshijiman などの日本酒、地酒の飲み放題。

cultural_comfort.note: One-person counter; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_standsix_gion.gf_detail: Ask: a drinks stand — coffee, homemade organic ginger and lemon syrups, matcha lemonade, spiced milk tea, beer and wine (Tabelog; 2020–2025 reviews). The only food mentioned is cookies (August 2026).
kyoto_standsix_gion.vegan_detail: Ask: syrup drinks, coffee, beer and wine (Tabelog; reviews); a latte and spiced milk tea contain milk (2022, 2024). Cookies were not described.
kyoto_standsix_gion.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 12:00–19:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–19:00; closed only over New Year. No reservations. No credit cards (Tabelog). 7 seats: counter, a few tables and an open terrace; smoking allowed on the terrace. Pets welcome; take-out. Free Wi-Fi and charging plugs (Tabelog). A small stand with a DJ booth in an alley by Gion Duck Noodle, a 2-min walk from Yasaka Shrine (Tabelog; December 2025 review). Opened 9 July 2016. Accessories by the London brand design6 and BUNCH stone jewelry for sale.
kyoto_standsix_gion.notes: [Stand café & bar · Gion by Yasaka Shrine, an alley terrace] A seven-seat stand with a DJ booth and a small terrace in a Gion alley: coffee, homemade ginger and lemon syrup drinks, matcha lemonade, beer and wine from midday, mostly under ¥1,000. English-speaking staff. Smoking on the terrace; cash only. Open daily except New Year.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 July 2016 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe friendly staff — a woman working alone who spoke fluent English (December 2025), and a staff member who set out a heater and blankets on the winter terrace (December 2022). A December 2022 reviewer notes it appeared on a comedy duo's YouTube channel and sits in an alley comedians pass.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade ginger and lemon syrup drinks; coffee; daytime drinks.

anecdotes.text: December 2025: "The female staff member was working solo, moving quickly and speaking fluent English—very impressive! The coffee was served in a generous mug, and I felt that JPY 600 was a great price."
August 2026: "The stylish interior and the open terrace seating are simply amazing! At first, I thought it was all about looks, but both the drinks and cookies were genuinely delicious."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: standsix、カフェ・バー、東山区祇園北側329 GION KOTOビル1F、八坂神社から徒歩2分・祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜金12:00〜19:00、土・日・祝11:00〜19:00、年末年始のみ休み、予約不可、カード不可、7席、テラス席は喫煙可、ペット可、テイクアウト可、Wi-Fiと電源あり、2016年7月9日オープン、自家製のオーガニックのしょうがシロップとレモンシロップのドリンク、ロンドンのブランドdesign6のアクセサリーとBUNCHの天然石のアクセサリーを販売。口コミ (2017年11月〜2026年8月、英語): ホットコーヒー600円 (2025年12月)、レモンシロップのビール、抹茶レモネード、シナモンのスパイスミルクティー、白ワイン、「6」の形のクッキー、DJブース、英語が堪能な女性スタッフ (2025年12月)、冬のテラスにヒーターと毛布 (2022年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff spoke fluent English (December 2025). Cash only; smoking on the terrace.

kyoto_gion_ishiya_yakiniku.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yakiniku with marinades, Kyoto-beef Wagyu katsu, bibim naengmyeon cold noodles and stone-grilled bibimbap (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ishiya_yakiniku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku restaurant built on Kyoto beef; oxtail gukbap, Wagyu sukiyaki with egg (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_ishiya_yakiniku.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Monday. Reservations taken. Cards, IC cards and PayPay. 35 seats: a counter on the 1st floor, tables on the 2nd with a view of Yasaka Shrine (2024–2026 reviews); private hire for 20–50. Designated smoking area; all seats non-smoking at lunch. Children welcome, with children's tableware. Meat for sale by the register (February 2026). Opposite the main gate of Yasaka Shrine, just south of the Shijo-dori corner (Tabelog). Opened 23 June 2016. One of three 石屋 yakiniku shops with 出町本店 and 太秦店 (regee.com).
kyoto_gion_ishiya_yakiniku.notes: [Yakiniku · opposite Yasaka Shrine, a second-floor view] A yakiniku house facing the gate of Yasaka Shrine — ask for the 2nd floor to look over it — grilling Kyoto beef, with Korean sides like stone-pot bibimbap and cold noodles. Lunch bowls and beef katsu from about ¥2,000–3,000; dinner around ¥8,000. Pricey for the area, some say. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 23 June 2016 (Tabelog), a Gion branch of the 石屋 yakiniku shops (出町本店 and 太秦店; regee.com). Reviewers describe a focus on Kyoto beef, attentive staff, many overseas guests and a full house of locals on a New Year Saturday (January 2025). Criticism: prices that seem aimed at tourists (March 2026), somewhat disorganized service (April 2026), and lunch on the pricier side (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-beef yakiniku; Wagyu katsu at lunch.

anecdotes.text: February 2024: "Considering the price, I expected not to receive high-quality meat, but I was pleasantly surprised to be served beautifully marbled cuts."
March 2026: "The meat was delicious, but I felt the prices were a bit high, possibly catering to tourists due to the location."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 石屋、焼肉・日本料理・居酒屋、東山区祇園町南側539、京阪祇園四条駅から八坂神社方面へ徒歩5分、突き当たりを南へ曲がってすぐ、火〜日・祝11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、月曜休み、予約可、カード・交通系IC・PayPay可、35席、貸切20〜50名、分煙 (ランチは全席禁煙)、子連れ可、2016年6月23日オープン。公式サイト (regee.com): 焼肉石屋 出町店本店・太秦店・祇園石屋。口コミ (2022年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 京都牛中心の焼肉、2階から八坂神社が見える、ランチの焼肉丼、京都牛の和牛カツ、飲み放題付きコース8,000円 (2024年2月)、ねぎタン塩、和牛すき焼き、ビビン冷麺、石焼チーズビビンバ、石焼ガーリックライス、テールクッパ、ランチは3,000円前後からとやや高め (2026年7月)、観光地価格との声 (2026年3月)、サービスが少し不慣れとの声 (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests and staff (2024–2026 reviews); children welcome.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated April, July and September 2026.

kyoto_hanamibashi_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Japanese courses with tempura, abalone and fugu fried in a rice-cracker coating, saikyo-miso grilled mackerel and simmered dishes (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hanamibashi_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood courses — sashimi, abalone, crab, fugu zosui — with some beef (2016–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hanamibashi_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 17:30–24:00; closed Sunday; hours and closed days may change, so check before visiting. Reservations taken. An October 2026 reviewer writes that first-time guests are not usually accepted and that the reviewer got in with a companion who had been before. Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners). A private room for 4 (2nd floor, February 2025). On Kiyamachi near Sanjo, with an entrance that is hard to find (2016 reviews).
kyoto_hanamibashi_kiyamachi.notes: [Japanese courses · Kiyamachi near Sanjo, a regulars' counter] A hidden Kiyamachi counter where a sociable owner pours rare sake and the chef sends out seafood courses — sashimi, abalone, winter fugu and kobako crab — at about ¥15,000–25,000. First-timers are usually turned away (October 2026 review), so go with a regular. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A September 2016 reviewer writes that the restaurant moved from Shichihonmatsu Marutamachi and specializes in seafood from Ise Bay ("I heard"), and that the owner welcomed guests while the head chef saw them off; an October 2016 reviewer mentions the owner and his wife. Later reviewers describe a friendly, straightforward owner who brings the counter of regulars together (December 2025). Criticism: a February 2025 business diner found the course ordinary and the private room lacking a place for coats.

anecdotes.text: December 2025: "The counter is filled with regular customers, but the friendly and straightforward owner connects everyone… just watching the owner from the counter is like enjoying a theatrical performance."
October 2026: "Although they usually don't accept first-time customers, I was allowed in this time because my companion had been here before."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 花美ばし、日本料理、中京区上大阪町524-1、三条から158m、月〜土17:30〜24:00、日曜休み、営業時間・定休日は変更の可能性あり、予約可、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、4名の個室、魚にこだわり、ブログ ameblo.jp/hanamibashi。口コミ (2016年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 木屋町の入口のわかりにくい店、Shichihonmatsu Marutamachiから移転したとの話、伊勢湾の魚介と聞いた (2016年9月)、店主と奥さん (2016年10月)、もろみ漬けのチーズ (2017年3月)、塩で食べる天ぷら (2023年1月)、2026年1月のコース (数の子と煮あわびの前菜、鯛・中トロ・あじの刺身、かぶの蒸し物、さばの西京焼き、あわびとふぐのあられ揚げ、こうばこがにの酢の物、ヒレ焼き、白子入りのふぐ雑炊、しらぬい)、日本酒の品ぞろえ、常連をつなぐ気さくな店主 (2025年12月)、一見さんは通常受けないとの記載 (2026年10月)、平凡なコースとの声 (2025年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Regulars' counter; first-time guests usually not accepted (October 2026 review) — go with someone who has been.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated December 2025, January 2026 and October 2026.

kyoto_petit_chalet_cheese.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: cheese dishes include carbonara, Gorgonzola penne, lasagna, baked cheese curry, loco moco and a cheese baguette (2023–2024 reviews). Cheese by weight and the cheesecake were not described as gluten-free — ask.
kyoto_petit_chalet_cheese.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a cheese shop — cheese, cheesecake with meringue, cheese dishes with minced meat (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_petit_chalet_cheese.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu, Fri 15:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; cheese and cake for sale daily 12:00–22:00 (Tabelog); check social media for changes. Reservations taken; a 2024 reviewer suggests calling ahead at busy times. Cards accepted. 12 seats: about 4 at the counter and tatami rooms in a renovated townhouse where shoes come off (2023–2025 reviews). Non-smoking. Sommelier on staff; take-out. On the way from Kiyomizu-Gojo to Rokuharamitsu-ji, 3 min walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo. Opened 4 August 2019.
kyoto_petit_chalet_cheese.notes: [Cheese shop & wine bar · Gojo near Kiyomizu-Gojo, a townhouse with tatami rooms] A cheese specialist in an old Kyoto townhouse: buy cheese or rich cheesecake by the gram, or sit on tatami for baked cheese curry, pasta and a cheese plate with wine. Pandas everywhere — even on the cake. About ¥2,000 for cake, ¥5,000 with wine. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Cheese professionals and sommeliers on staff
chef_bio.background: Opened 4 August 2019 (Tabelog). A February 2024 reviewer writes that three staff hold a specialist cheese qualification, one of them also a pastry chef, alongside qualified sommeliers. Reviewers describe an owner who loves pandas (panda meringues and decorations), homemade side dishes, and a friendly counter of regulars (2024–2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Cheesecake by weight; cheese dishes; cheese and wine pairing.

anecdotes.text: February 2024: "Not only do they sell cheese by weight, but they also offer cheesecakes by weight. You can point out how much you want, whether it's in grams or by gesturing."
May 2023: "I was impressed by the baked cheese curry for JPY 1430 at the cheese shop… a delightful blend of seven types of cheese."

kyoto_neko_chigura.gf_detail: Ask. A sake bar with a few snacks — edamame, broccoli with sesame dressing, grilled sardines; no gluten information (September 2025).
kyoto_neko_chigura.vegan_detail: Ask. Edamame and broccoli with sesame dressing are on the short snack list, but nothing is said about dashi or sauces (September 2025).
kyoto_neko_chigura.hours_raw: Opening days and hours vary — check the shop’s Instagram (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 6 counter seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking, ashtray outside (Tabelog). Reservations recommended — it fills up fast (April 2026). At the very back of the 三条食彩ろぉじ alley off Sanjo-Sakaimachi, 5 min from exit 5 of Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog; September 2025). Opened 2 September 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_neko_chigura.notes: [Sake bar · Sanjo-Sakaimachi alley, six seats] A tiny cat-themed sake bar at the back of the 三条食彩ろぉじ alley, run single-handed by a young owner in kimono who loves sake: describe your taste, or start with a three-sake tasting set (¥1,500), with a few simple snacks. Good for beginners and solo drinkers. Cash only; hours vary — check Instagram.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a young woman owner who runs the bar alone (September 2025), wears kimono behind the counter, and opened it as a place to enjoy sake casually and alone — something the owner had not done before (September 2025). Plans were mentioned to sell sake upstairs (September 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Sake made easy for beginners and solo drinkers (September 2025).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 sake novice tried a beginner-friendly bottle that tasted sweet-and-sour, like a grown-up Calpis.
An April 2026 visitor found it empty at 7 pm on a weekend and full ten minutes later.

kyoto_gion_zakoya.gf_detail: Ask. Fish dishes, grilled squid with mayonnaise, anago and tuna katsu, croquettes, salad pasta and butter chicken curry; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_zakoya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led izakaya with meat dishes (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_zakoya.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 19:00–05:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original 頂いておりません). Reservations recommended (February 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 8–10 counter seats (Tabelog; February 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Ground floor of ピックルビル on the north-west corner, 70 m west of Gion Kagetsu Minami, 10 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_zakoya.notes: [Izakaya · Gion, fish till 5 am] A small Gion counter open from 7 pm to 5 am, where a cheerful cook serves fresh fish from around Japan — bonito, the signature thick grilled squid, fluffy anago katsu — with croquettes, salad pasta and a much-loved curry to finish. No service charge; smoking allowed; closed Sunday.

kyoto_anzuya_gion_ishiya_hanare.gf_detail: Ask. Oden from long-used pots, meat sashimi and grilled meat with ponzu, potato salad and omakase courses; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_anzuya_gion_ishiya_hanare.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden in dashi, meat sashimi, outside skirt and tuna (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_anzuya_gion_ishiya_hanare.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday and holidays 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Monday (Tabelog). Walk-ins possible (August 2026); courses and private rooms for groups (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). 16 seats with a counter and private rooms (Tabelog; October 2026). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). Just off the main street in south Gion, 5 min from the Gion bus stop (Tabelog). Opened 11 October 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_anzuya_gion_ishiya_hanare.notes: [Oden and meat · south Gion, a quiet house] A 16-seat Gion house with a counter and private rooms, pairing oden from long-used pots with meat sashimi and grilled cuts from a yakiniku kitchen’s know-how — or let the owner cook an omakase. Closed Monday. Flagged: run by 石屋株式会社, which reviewers say also runs yakiniku and sushi restaurants.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T4130001051620 is registered to 石屋株式会社, 祇園町南側539 (NTA register). An August 2026 reviewer says the same company runs several restaurants, including yakiniku and sushi. A September 2025 diner describes a quick-witted owner who knows a great deal about Noh.
chef_bio.philosophy: The old elegance of Gion at reasonable prices (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 first-timer came on after a Noh performance at Kanze Kaikan, walking along the Shirakawa, and left the menu to the owner.
An August 2026 passer-by was drawn in by the meat sashimi and oden on the board outside and could have eaten five more pieces of oden harusame.
